# netbox_device_power_outlet (Data Source)

A device power outlet (dcim.poweroutlet).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/poweroutlet/):

> Power outlets represent the outlets on a power distribution unit (PDU) or other device that supplies power to dependent devices. Each power port may be assigned a physical type, and may be associated with a specific feed leg (where three-phase power is used) and/or a specific upstream power port. This association can be used to model the distribution of power within a device.

For example, imagine a PDU with one power port which draws from a three-phase feed and 48 power outlets arranged into three banks of 16 outlets each. Outlets 1-16 would be associated with leg A on the port, and outlets 17-32 and 33-48 would be associated with legs B and C, respectively.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_power_outlet" "test" {
  name = "test-device_power_outlet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `name` (String)
- `name_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the name.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `type` (String) Outlet type as its NetBox slug, e.g. iec-60320-c13, nema-5-15r (any of NetBox's power outlet type choices).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `feed_leg` (String) Phase (for three-phase feeds). One of: A, B, C.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected.
- `module_id` (Number) Id of the installed module this component belongs to.
- `power_port_id` (Number) Id of the upstream power port on the same device.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
